name: inspira-text-generate-effect
blurb: Text appears word-by-word as if being typed out.
description: Displays text with a typewriter-like effect, words entering sequentially with staggered timing. Runs once on mount or scroll trigger.
use_when: Narratives, announcements, or storytelling sections where sequence matters.
avoid_when: Long passages — typing animation makes content unavailable until complete.
a11y: Text is hidden until animation runs; screen readers may announce before animation completes.
